title: The K menu
summary: The menu key, how to move around the menu and every page in it.

s.x: and one window opens with everything the pack adds: the SkyBlock Menu, your character, skills, slayers, storage, the Bazaar and Auction House, collections and settings. It has a sidebar of pages on the left and a dark custom look instead of vanilla screens. This page explains how to use the menu and lists every page, in the order they appear.

rows.x: Open the menu, on the page you last used (the SkyBlock Menu the first time). Press again to close.
Step back inside a page, for example clear a search. Closes the menu when there is nowhere left to go back.
Jump to one of the first nine pages
Click a page in the sidebar
Scroll the list of pages, when they don't all fit

s.x: A page with a text field, such as the Auction House, Bazaar, Party or Settings, takes digits and letters first.
The window fits itself to your screen.
lets you pick Auto, Compact or Large. See
On a small screen nothing is out of reach:
When the pages don't all fit down the sidebar, the list scrolls. A thin scrollbar and a fade show where it is cut off, and picking a page with the keys scrolls it into view.
A page taller than the window scrolls inside it, with a scrollbar on the right. Tiles and cards keep a readable size instead of being squashed.
The sidebar lists the pages in this order:

The SkyBlock date and what is on. See

Warps to your island, the Hub and the islands you have visited. See

s.x: The survival game's pages for Talents, Contracts, the Journal, Mounts, Titles and Pay are switched off in SkyBlock and do not show.
Your character is on the left. On the right is a tile for each thing the mods register:
, shown in aqua, which is also the badge in chat.
One tile for every stat: Health, Defense, Strength, Crit Chance and so on.
Tiles fill one to three columns, depending on the window, and scroll when there are more than fit. A number too long for its tile is shortened, such as
. Hover to see it in full. See
The main stats as tiles, in four groups:

Mining Speed, Mining Fortune, Farming Fortune, Foraging Fortune, Fishing Speed, Sea Creature Chance, Fishing Fortune
Farming, Mining, Foraging, Combat and Fishing Wisdom

s.x: Hover a tile to see what the stat does and where your bonuses come from: skills, gear, slayer levels, pets and your SkyBlock Level. Hypixel's other stats are on item tooltips but have no tile yet. See
